title: Goldman Sachs: Alphabet and Amazon generated "other income" totaling $53B in Q1, or ~60% of their Q1 income; $49B was due to equity stakes in private companies (Robin Wigglesworth/Financial Times)
summary: Robin Wigglesworth / Financial Times: Goldman Sachs: Alphabet and Amazon generated “other income” totaling $53B in Q1, or ~60% of their Q1 income; $49B was due to equity stakes in private companies — The AI “hyperscalers” reported bumper earnings for the first quarter, with both sales and profits beating expectations.
contentText:
Robin Wigglesworth / Financial Times :

Goldman Sachs: Alphabet and Amazon generated “other income” totaling $53B in Q1, or ~60% of their Q1 income; $49B was due to equity stakes in private companies   —  The AI “hyperscalers” reported bumper earnings for the first quarter, with both sales and profits beating expectations.
